$description: Decision 0063: one label rule for everything floating in its own color. A FAB in a color other than the default, and the vibrant toolbar, are glass tinted with their color at the owner's 90% (decision 0032) where their label reads at 4.5:1 over a pure black or white backdrop; the build raises a tint one step at a time only as far as the label needs, per mode (scripts/build-tokens.mjs, com.s4.label-tint). core.js applies the same rule to every seed; scripts/check-glass.mjs proves it.

fab-secondary-container.$description: A secondary-container FAB's tint: the floor (fab-color) raised only as far as its label needs.

fab-tertiary-container.$description: A tertiary-container FAB's tint: the floor (fab-color) raised only as far as its label needs (monochrome light mode was 3.85:1 at 90%).

fab-primary.$description: A primary FAB's tint: the floor (fab-color) raised only as far as its label needs.

fab-secondary.$description: A secondary FAB's tint: the floor (fab-color) raised only as far as its label needs.

fab-tertiary.$description: A tertiary FAB's tint: the floor (fab-color) raised only as far as its label needs.

toolbar-vibrant.$description: The vibrant toolbar's tint (decision 0063 ends its exception): the floor raised only as far as its labels need.
